rules: Provider and pack failures are not quality losses and must not be scored as zero-quality cases.
A completion failure is fail-soft only when pass-one projection survives; otherwise classify the records contract failure.
Structural, readiness and provenance are non-regression guards; improvements on those axes are not positive-quality promotion authority.
An unbased AI inference is a governed comparison metric, not an automatic case failure; a candidate may not increase its matched total.
An incomplete or configuration-mismatched pair is HOLD, never PASS or FAIL.
Missing, non-integer, non-finite, negative, or over-generated served-disclosure counts fail closed; any unsurfaced disclosure keeps comparison on HOLD.
Stored scores and summaries are untrusted: verifier and comparator must recompute them from exact captures and briefs and reject any mismatch.

Identity, configuration, exact-coverage, stored-evidence and disclosure eligibility failures are HOLD and dominate simultaneous structural, readiness or provenance regression signals. Only an otherwise eligible pair may FAIL an authentic replayed non-regression breach.

The legacy scorer is executable diagnostic-only. Complete or incomplete legacy gains cannot produce PASS or a quality FAIL; until a grounding-sensitive positive-quality authority exists, eligible comparisons remain HOLD with QUALITY_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE.
